title: LOS40 Primavera Pop set for October Argentina debut
summary: Spanish festival LOS40 Primavera Pop is to expand into Latin America with a debut edition in Argentina this October, after the rights to the brand were acquired by EB Producciones CEO Eduardo Basagaña. title: Live Nation makes major CEE move by acquiring trio of Prague venues
summary: With its largest investment in the CEE region to date, Live Nation has acquired a majority stake in three of Prague’s leading venues: the O2 Arena (20,000), O2 Universum (5,000), and Forum Karlín (4,000). The alliance will see the venues, some of Czechia’s most important cultural destinations, folded into Live Nation’s global venue portfolio. The company says the spaces will remain open to all artists, promoters, and event organisers. title: Conference news: SoAlive and Radar Madrid reveal lineups for 2026
summary: Bulgaria-based industry conference SoAlive has revealed its “strongest lineup yet” for its return to Sofia, which organisers said reflects its “growing position within the wider European music industry calendar”. As part of the first wave of international speakers, the conference will welcome Scott Cohen, chief innovation officer at Warner Music Group, UK-based label executive Nick Halkes, Ruth Barlow, director of live licensing at Beggars Group, and Paul Schäfer, head of brand and festival experience at Lollapalooze Berlin and Superbloom. title: Two Canadian music rights orgs join to streamline royalties
summary: In a move aimed at streamlining music royalties in Canada, leading performing rights organisation SOCAN has acquired the Canadian Musical Reproduction Rights Agency (CMRRA), bringing the country’s two main music rights organisations under one umbrella. With the acquisition from SoundExchange, SOCAN – the Society of Composers, Authors and Music Publishers of Canada – will add mechanical rights administration to its existing performance rights and international royalty services. CMRRA will continue as a standalone unit while benefiting from SOCAN’s resources and network.
